coin.title: 70 years miffy 1 Gram Silver Bar in finecard
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KI49EJE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A unique issue for miffy's 70th birthday! Especially for the birthday anniversary of the worlds favorite bunny, the Royal Dutch Mint is launching a 1 gram Silver bar. It is without a doubt the most unique Silver bar you have ever seen: a real must-have! 70 years of miffy It is the year 1955 when miffy comes to life in the sketches of illustrator Dick Bruna. He uses them to tell stories to his son: this turns out to be such a success that Dick Bruna decides to publish a book. The very first miffy book is published in 1955 and this is the start of a very successful series: miffy is super popular! Nowadays, this fictional animal can be found in almost every household with small children. In addition to books, there are many other products available, such as cards, games, clocks, bags, toys and more. And now there is also a very unique miffy silver bar for sale! Design The 70 years of miffy Silver bar weighs 1 Gram and is packaged in a nice fine card. The front of the fine card features the 70 years of miffy logo. The back has the 70 years of miffy logo, with an image next to it that features miffy in its entirety. Below that is information about the Silver bar and the guaranteed purity. On the right you see the illustration of a cheerful miffy.
